subject: Observability plan for POC - next steps
messages:

Subject: Observability plan for POC - next steps

Hi Elena / team,

Thanks again for the time this morning - great conversation. Quick recap and proposed next steps for the POC observability scope we discussed: 

POC scope (agreed):
- 2-week technical POC against our staging model endpoint (dedicated pool)
- Evaluate latency, error rates, and output quality under representative traffic (synthetic and replay)
- Validate dashboarding, tracing, and log export to your S3 bucket

Success criteria (to confirm):
1) Median inference latency (p50) <= 120ms and p95 <= 300ms for 512-token requests
2) End-to-end error rate < 0.5% under 5 qps sustained
3) Full request/response logging to your S3 (sampling at 1:1 during replay, 1:10 for live)
4) Dashboards with p50/p95/p99 latency, token-level throughput, and per-route error breakdown
5) Tracing spans correlated to request IDs to root cause 95% of observed errors

Evaluation plan / timeline:
- Kickoff + infra access: next Monday (2026-10-26)
- Week 1: baseline runs + dashboard/tracing setup
- Week 2: replay traffic, tuning, and final evaluation + wrap-up call

Ownership:
- Redwood: Jordan (you), Marissa (POC lead / QA), Marcus (observability engineer)
- FinTechX: Elena (product lead), Raj (SRE / QA)

Next steps (action items):
- Jordan: share detailed observability plan (attached) and HubSpot deal + Drive link
- Elena: confirm success criteria above and provide access details (staging endpoint creds, S3 bucket write role)
- Marissa / Marcus: prepare dashboard templates and tracing instrumentation checklist

Attachments: observability_plan_v1.pdf, poc-success-criteria.xlsx
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cobs-plan
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/FTX-342

Can you confirm these criteria and the kickoff time?

Thanks,
Jordan Blake

Thanks Jordan - this looks good. A couple small tweaks / questions from our side: 

- For success criteria #3 (log export), we need logs to include request_id, model_version, and prompt hash. Can you confirm those fields are included in your export schema?
- Retention: we typically require 90-day retention for POC logs (short term) - is that configurable on your side?
- Do you support trace sampling and full-trace collection during replay runs? We want full traces for the replay and sampled traces for live.

We can confirm kickoff next Monday; Raj will follow up with staging endpoint credentials and S3 write role by EOD today. Adding procurement (procurement@fintechx.com) to the thread for the contract/terms touchpoint.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2026-10-25T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Observability plan for POC - internal plan and asks

Thanks - forwarding our internal plan / checklist for observability so we can move quickly once creds come in. High-level dashboard/tracing/logging items for Marcus / Dev to pick up: 

Dashboards (minimum):
- Inference overview: p50/p95/p99 latency, tokens/sec, requests/sec, concurrent sessions
- Error dashboard: 5xx/4xx by route, top error messages, user-facing vs system errors
- Cost/Throughput: token cost estimate, GPU utilization, batching efficiency
- Data quality: sample responses, prompt/response diff stats (for quality checks)

Tracing / logs:
- Tracing: OpenTracing-compatible spans, include request_id, model_version, route, and shard_id
- Logs: Structured JSON with request_id, user_id (anonymized), prompt_hash, model_version, start_ts, end_ts, latency_ms, error_code, full_response (optional - kept for replay only)
- Export: S3 sink with 90-day lifecycle rule; support for gzip + partition by date

Metrics to monitor (suggested names):
- redwood.inference.latency.p50
- redwood.inference.latency.p95
- redwood.inference.latency.p99
- redwood.inference.error.rate
- redwood.inference.tokens.per.second
- redwood.inference.kv_cache.hit_rate

Retention / sampling:
- Replay: full logs + full traces (1:1)
- Live: request sampling 1:10, trace sampling 1:100 unless triggered by an alert

Action items:
- Marcus: please provision dashboard templates (use redwood_dashboard_template.json) and set up a tracing collector for the staging cluster. Target: EOW Friday (2026-10-30).
- Dev: work with FinTechX SRE to configure S3 sink and IAM role mapping.

I attached a dashboard template and the initial observability plan. Let me know if we should tighten any acceptance thresholds.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole

Got it - I'll take ownership of the dashboards and tracing. Quick notes on delivery and config: 

- Will create the four dashboards Marissa listed and a lightweight runbook for common alerts (high p95, error rate spike, sustained latency increase).
- Dashboard ETA: 2026-10-30 EOD. Will wire metrics to both Grafana (internal) and export key panels to the FinTechX shared Grafana org (read-only).
- Tracing: set up Jaeger collector with span tags: request_id, model_version, route, shard_id. Will enable full traces for replay runs and 1:100 sampling for live.
- Logs: will push structured JSON to S3 with gzip and daily partitioning. Retention lifecycle rule of 90 days.

Attachments: redwood_dashboard_template.json
